_doc.what: The Scene book. Data-driven aquarium backgrounds. The Tank renderer (scene.js) reads this file at load and builds one background per entry. Scenes auto-rotate on a timer with a crossfade; press M / ArrowRight / ArrowLeft to cycle manually during review.
_doc.add_a_scene: Append an object to `scenes`. Minimum = {id, name, palette:{top,mid,bottom}, glow}. That alone gives a gradient sky + palette-tinted drifting glows (the 'simple' tier, like ocean/sunset/moonlight). Add `decorations` pointing at a registered procedural art id (see decoration_ids) to draw a seabed scene on top. No engine edit needed for a new palette-only scene.
_doc.add_illustrated_art_later: SEAM (not built yet): add a `backdrop_image` field with a RELATIVE url (e.g. 'static/scenes/reef.jpg'). scene.js has a hook — when backdrop_image is present it should draw that image as the base layer (behind/instead of the gradient) and skip the procedural gradient. The gradient palette then only tints the glows. This lets a hand-illustrated backdrop drop in per scene with no other change. Keep images at display resolution (<= ~1920px long side) for the TV memory ceiling.

fields.id: stable slug, used in code / URLs
fields.name: display name shown in the rotation banner
fields.kind: 'simple' (gradient only) or 'scene' (gradient + a decoration layer). Cosmetic/metadata; the presence of `decorations` is what actually adds art.
fields.palette: {top,mid,bottom} vertical gradient stops as [r,g,b] 0-255. top=surface light, bottom=deep floor.
fields.glow: [r,g,b] tint of the soft drifting light blobs.
fields.decorations: id of a procedural art function registered in scene.js DECORATIONS, or null. Ported 1:1 from v1's canvas-2D art, rendered once into an offscreen canvas -> PIXI texture in the decoration layer (parallax-able).
fields.parallax: how much the decoration layer shifts vs the camera drift (0 = locked to floor). Optional, default 0.06.
fields.water: {tint:[r,g,b] optional, alpha 0-1} overrides for the caustics/water overlay per scene. Optional.
fields.backdrop_image: OPTIONAL relative url of an illustrated backdrop. Not yet consumed by the renderer — reserved seam (see add_illustrated_art_later).
fields.events: OPTIONAL scene event rules, e.g. {"on_block": "light_surge"}. Reserved seam for block-reactive scenes; renderer ignores unknown rules today.

_doc.config: Rotation interval + crossfade duration are CONFIG constants in scene.js (ROTATE_EVERY_S, BLEND_DURATION_S).
_doc.order: Scene list order = display rotation order; a DECORATED scene goes first so the wall never opens on a plain gradient (owner feedback 2026-07-02).
